# Requirements — Net collection

## R1 · event · risk: none
WHEN a collection is created THE SYSTEM SHALL record it with status pending.

## R2 · event · risk: none
WHEN the same collection request arrives twice THE SYSTEM SHALL apply side effects exactly once.

## P1 · property
For any sequence of collection requests, the number of ledger entries SHALL equal the number of distinct request ids.
Validates: R2
files.design.md:
# Design — Net collection

## Context
Failed card payments are retried by hand.
## Options considered
A: scheduled job. B: event-driven retry. B chosen.
## Decision
Event-driven retry with an idempotency key per request id.
## Consequences
Needs a dedup table.
## Data changes
New table collection(request_id unique).
## Interfaces and contracts
POST /collections.
## Failure modes
Duplicate delivery; partial failure between insert and publish.
## Migration
Additive.
## Rollout and flag
Flag net_collect, default off.
## Observability
Counter collections_created.
## Security notes
Merchant-scoped.
## Consumer trace
None changed.
